hero.headline: Software, apps and AI built in Nepal

services.title: Software development and marketing, in one team
services.intro: Build it, test it, market it. Choose one service or combine several. Each service is priced on its own.

cards.title: Websites
cards.text: A fast website that shows your business well and brings in customers, on any phone.

cards.title: Mobile apps
cards.text: Apps for Android and iPhone, built with the technology that fits your goal and budget.

cards.title: Custom software
cards.text: Software made for the way you work, from internal tools to full online platforms.

cards.title: AI agents
cards.text: An AI agent answers customer questions and handles routine tasks, so your team can focus on people.

cards.title: QA and testing
cards.text: We test your website or app before your customers do, and report every problem clearly.

cards.title: Audits
cards.text: An honest review of your code, design or search ranking, with a clear list of what to fix.

cards.title: Dedicated team
cards.text: Developers, designers, QA and DevOps who work for you full time on a contract.

cards.title: Digital marketing
cards.text: Search, social media, paid ads and influencers, planned to bring you real enquiries.

cards.title: Offline marketing
cards.text: Events, print and on-the-ground activities that put your brand in front of people in Kathmandu.

rent.title: Rent what you need. Pay every month.
rent.intro: No big payment at the start. You pay a monthly price that depends on the size of your company.

cards.title: Website on rent
cards.text: A ready, professional website with hosting, updates and support included.

cards.title: AI agent on rent
cards.text: One AI agent that answers your customers on one channel, trained on your own information.

cards.title: Team on rent
cards.text: Add a developer, designer or tester to your team for a month, or longer.

points.title: Prices you can see

points.title: Build and marketing together
points.text: One company makes your product and promotes it. You do not manage two agencies.

points.title: Based in Nepal
points.text: We speak your language, know your market and work from Nepal.

points.title: Pay in the way that suits you

steps.title: Talk
steps.text: Tell us about your business and your goal. We listen and ask questions.

steps.title: Plan and quote
steps.text: We suggest a plan and send a clear quote, so you know what you get and what it costs.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We make your website, app, agent or campaign. You see progress and give feedback.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.text: We go live together. Then we stay available to fix problems and help you improve.

event.title: Join us at our opening
event.text: We open ADMMIS.TECH to the public on 1 January 2027. Come and meet the team.

items.q: How much does a website or app cost?
items.a: It depends on the service and the size of your company. Our packages are on the pricing page. For larger projects, tell us your goal and we send a quote.
You pay a monthly price instead of a large payment at the start. We look after hosting, updates and support. Read the plans to see what is included.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Nepal?
items.a: Yes. We work with clients in Nepal and in other countries. Our pricing is also shown in US dollars.
